user.description: Adds a TAB-1 panel to the sidebar, where you build dashboards for the Apollo TAB-1 tablet and choose which dashboard each tablet shows. It also finds the TAB-1 tablets that are already set up through ESPHome. There is nothing to configure.

approval_needed.message: An admin must turn this tablet on first: in the TAB-1 panel, pick a dashboard for it, then press "Turn on with this dashboard".

not_loaded.message: Apollo TAB Dashboard is not loaded

esphome_internals.title: Dashboards cannot reach the tablets
esphome_internals.description: This version of Home Assistant changed how ESPHome devices are reached, so Apollo TAB Dashboard cannot send dashboards to the TAB-1 tablets. Update Apollo TAB Dashboard.

new_tablet.title: New TAB-1 tablet found: {name}
new_tablet.description: New TAB-1 tablet found: {name}. Open TAB-1 in the sidebar, pick a dashboard for it and press "Turn on with this dashboard". If you do not know this device, remove it from ESPHome.

show_dashboard.name: Show dashboard
show_dashboard.description: Shows a dashboard on a TAB-1 tablet. Only admins and automations can use it. A new tablet must first be turned on by an admin: in the TAB-1 panel, pick a dashboard for it, then press "Turn on with this dashboard". An admin can also turn it on with this action.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.description: The dashboard's "Name for automations", shown in the editor under "This dashboard", for example tab-home.
